summary: Describes message processing and dispatching for SNMP within the SNMP architecture: how messages of different versions are sent to the right processing model, and how PDUs go to the right applications. It also describes the SNMPv3 message processing model. It obsoletes RFC 2272 and was replaced by RFC 3412.

eli5.summary: Like a mailroom, this sorts incoming network-management messages by version and sends each to the right desk.
